projectName: Web Portfolio Dashboard and Wallet Views
description: Deliver the daily-use portfolio experience for phone and desktop: total BTC holdings, cost basis, custody posture, wallet balances, and recent activity, all backed by the Python query core.

timing.gatingCondition: Proceed after Feature-17 foundation and after tax/reporting endpoints are stable enough to share model conventions.

principles: Phone First, Desktop Better - core stats must be fast and readable from a phone, with richer drill-down on larger screens
Operator Clarity - highlight the balances and custody posture that matter for sovereignty decisions
No Hidden Inference - if wallet custody is inferred rather than explicit, say so
Fast Read Paths - portfolio endpoints should remain cheap enough for habitual use
Reuse Existing Domain Queries - derive outputs from WalletQuery, BalanceCalculator, and TransactionQuery rather than bespoke SQL sprawl

techStack.frontend: Web UI with responsive tables/cards/charts as needed
techStack.testing: pytest API tests + frontend smoke coverage

userStories.title: Portfolio summary API and mobile dashboard
acceptanceCriteria: Expose total BTC balance, average basis, wallet count, and recent transaction summary via one authenticated dashboard endpoint
Design phone-friendly cards for balance, basis, custody, and quick navigation
Keep initial dashboard latency low enough for habitual use
Preserve parity with current TUI/dashboard summary values
userStories.testStrategy: pytest dashboard endpoint tests with representative ledger fixtures

userStories.title: Wallet balances and custody breakdown
acceptanceCriteria: Expose per-wallet balances, percentages of total, active status, and custody type
Render custody breakdown clearly with explicit notice when values are inferred from heuristics
Allow toggling inactive wallets on and off
Support coin selection with BTC as the default
userStories.testStrategy: pytest wallet summary API tests and UI filtering smoke tests

userStories.title: Wallet detail view with recent activity
acceptanceCriteria: Provide wallet detail route showing balance, custody metadata, and recent related transactions
Support direct deep links suitable for phone bookmark usage
Allow quick jump from wallet view into ledger and tax flows
Reuse existing transaction filtering logic from the Python core
userStories.testStrategy: pytest wallet detail endpoint tests with linked transaction fixtures

userStories.title: Recent transactions strip and quick actions
acceptanceCriteria: Show recent transactions on the dashboard with type, wallet, amount, and date
Add quick actions for record transaction, view ledger, and open tax forecast
Keep quick actions reachable in one tap on mobile
Ensure the UI remains useful even when the dataset is empty
userStories.testStrategy: Frontend smoke tests + API empty-state checks
userStories.closureNotes: Recent tx strip and empty states complete. Quick-action buttons removed by design — navbar provides navigation, record-transaction deferred to a future actions feature.

userStories.title: Dashboard caching and refresh policy
acceptanceCriteria: Document whether dashboard reads are fully live or lightly cached
Provide explicit refresh affordance rather than ambiguous stale data
Ensure write flows invalidate or refresh the right portfolio views
Avoid introducing background complexity before it is needed
userStories.testStrategy: Manual behavior verification + targeted invalidation tests
userStories.closureNotes: Dashboard uses fully live queries with no caching — appropriate for single-operator use. No write flows exist on web yet so invalidation is N/A. No premature background complexity introduced.

high: If dashboard numbers drift from tax or ledger views, trust in the web app will drop quickly
Overly heavy dashboard queries could make habitual phone usage unpleasant
medium: Custody inference may be misread as authoritative metadata unless labeled carefully
Desktop and mobile needs differ enough that one layout may not serve both well without deliberate design
low: The portfolio surface is mostly read-only and composes cleanly from existing query classes
The TUI already defines the right conceptual scope for the first web dashboard

preFlightChecklist: Decide whether dashboard should include integrity/attestation teaser now or later
Confirm phone navigation priorities for top-level tabs/actions
Define exact empty-state language for a new database

implementedSoFar: Shared web shell with desktop sidebar and mobile bottom nav patterned after familyPulse
Dashboard is now the default landing page while tax has its own dedicated /tax route
Authenticated /api/portfolio/dashboard endpoint exposes total BTC balance, basis, custody buckets, wallet balances, and recent transactions
Compact header session control replaces the earlier oversized logout CTA
Browser smoke coverage now validates dashboard-first navigation into the tax workspace
